NEXT PRIORITY: build CLI-as-first-class-agent-target (#117, milestone v1.1.0 #8). Design + decisions complete — full plan in project.cliAgentParity, design in docs/design-117-cli-agent-parity.md. Driver: a user's employer bans MCP servers, so CLI is the only agent path for that cohort.

STATE: design doc + store scaffolding committed on branch feat/cli-agent-parity-117 (commit 3f7477b). NOT pushed; main is clean. Checkout the branch to continue.

DECIDED last session (2026-05-27): D3 locked (unify all --json under one versioned envelope, accept the bare-JSON read break). All THREE workstreams in v1.1.0. Sequence WS1 -> WS2 -> WS3. Only open Q is D7 (whether to build rvr manifest) — decide at WS2 impl time.

START WS1 HERE: build src/utils/output.ts FIRST — envelope types {reverie,ok,command,result,warnings,error}, emitResult/emitError/emitJson helpers, frozen error.code enum, own unit tests. Purely additive, nothing routes through it yet, so it can't leave a half-migrated contract. THEN wire the global --json root flag + RVR_OUTPUT=json env, then route each command through the chokepoint, then migrate existing bare---json reads into result. WS1 is a breaking-change PR — do it in one coherent pass, its own PR, CHANGELOG ### Changed + ### Added.

EARLY WS2 correctness bug: src/llm-instructions.ts DEFAULT_LLM_INSTRUCTIONS tells a CLI agent to "PREFER MCP TOOLS" it can't reach — needs surface-aware getEffectiveInstructions('cli'|'mcp') split.
